item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The code must build a runnable DSPy module/example pair, pass the module through `wrap_program`, and invoke the returned wrapper on the example, because that is the helper path `SIMBA.compile` uses to execute candidate programs.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The demo metric must return a `dspy.Prediction` with a required aggregate `score` field and additional named fields for auxiliary reward data.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The code must verify that the wrapped output's top-level `score` equals the aggregate reward taken from the metric's `score` field.","span_ids":["s3","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The code must verify that `output_metadata` equals the metric's non-`score` fields, demonstrating that auxiliary subscores and feedback are preserved and remain available to SIMBA downstream.","span_ids":["s3","s5"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The code must also verify that the wrapped result still exposes the original program output under `prediction`.","span_ids":["s4"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/teleprompt/simba.py","start_line":203,"end_line":205},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/teleprompt/simba_utils.py","start_line":34,"end_line":49},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/teleprompt/simba_utils.py","start_line":48,"end_line":59},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/teleprompt/simba_utils.py","start_line":63,"end_line":69},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/teleprompt/simba_utils.py","start_line":139,"end_line":152}]}
